title: 恵比寿島ナイト
caption: Hard-hitting late 1980s funk rap with a Japanese city pop gloss. An energetic male MC raps in Japanese with a punchy, rhythmic delivery, and a crew shouts the chorus together in call and response. Heavy drum machine beat with a booming kick and a cracking snare, growling synth bass, sharp funk guitar, synth brass riffs, record scratches, a talk box melody. Tough, exciting, street racers gathering in a floodlit parking area by the bay at night. Loud, punchy production.
